content: Lan i gan mweluluga kekeisi, Yosuwa alonau ge Isileli gegewel hi lut Sitim hi eguluwan, inoke hi na Wewel Yolidani elana. Yaka hi holaviya ga to, mulaa abwe nihi kalapanet.
Lan etonina elana, inoke tohouwa hi nopain abaholaviya,
ge hi baek gamagalau elal hi ba, “Sauga topowon un Libai nuku kitel Yehoba wala Yabowaine wana Bateli ana Dedewaga nihi kalivai, yaka abaholavi nuku eguluwan ge nuku toulilil.
Inoke kamwasa nihi pankitemiu, kaiwena nige sauga etega ku nonoem labi ya elana. Bahi nuku nonok Bateli ana Dedewaga labenaa, ami bwaga ni gan ana yapu ni ola kilomita maisena.”
Yaka Yosuwa i baek gamagalau elal i ba, “Ku pwabwabwalena-agimiu, kaiwena bwaligumwa Yehoba ginol yawiyawi enuna ni ginolil gamwalaa.”
Lan i gan mwelulugaa inoke Yosuwa i baek topowon elal i ba, “Bateli ana Dedewaga ku kalivai ge nuku nohouwa gamagalau awoliyaa.” Inoke hi ginol ola Yosuwa wana baaba.
Yehoba i baek Yosuwa elana i ba, “Lan ebe na telipuna alam na teli heyan boda Isileli mataliyaa. Inoke nihi atena nau alou owa, i ola valila alou Mosese.
Nu baek topowon bolo Bateli ana Dedewaga ana tokaval elal nu ba, ‘Sauga nuku pulivin Wewel Yolidani bebenaa, yaka nuku gailau ge nuku talmilil wewel gamwanaa.’”
Inoke Yosuwa i baek boda Isileli elal i ba, “Ku noanim ga, inoke Yehoba wala Yabowaine wana baaba na wasaan nuku hago.
Lan ya bugul etega ni gan, inoke nuku atena age Yabowaine yawalina gaganina iyahe avala ge abwe Kenani, Hiti, Hivi, Pelisi, Gegasi, Amoli ge Yebusi towohiliyau ni takel yohil kaiwemiu.
He panayawi mamanana ana Babala wana Bateli ana Dedewaga nasi ni houwa-agimiu ni na ni lau Wewel Yolidani elana.

Inoke sauga topowon bolo Dedewaga hi kalivai aeliya nihi teli Yolidani elana, yaka wewel toto i sani loem natiya nasi ni kekepa ge ni tub papahe abana maisena. (He i ola al bolau ali gewi elulutega eluwa nuku hilel un maisena ge maisena gamwaliyaa.)”

Witi tomwatomwa ana sauga inoke banata i sani Wewel Yolidani elana. Sauga Isileli wali abaholavi hi eguluwai hi na Yolidani nihi kalapanet-an, inoke topowon Dedewaga hi kalivai ge hi houwa gamagalau awoliyaa. Sauga toto topowon aeliya hi teli wewel gamwanaa,

yaka wewel toto i sani loem natiya i kekepa. Wewel i tub papahe labi etega ana bwaga i yapu elal, panuwa alana Adama, Saletan labenaa. Wewel toto i sani lok i na Hoga Alialigana elana i kekepa hot, inoke gamagalau bosowailiya nihi kalapanet Yeliko gegelinaa.
Topowon bolo Yehoba wana Bateli ana Dedewaga hi kalivai hi talmilil bubun bilibili kekevana elana Yolidani ana luwaluwala, yaka Isileli hi noknok ana siga gegewel hi kalapanet haba.
